sources.title: Ben-David, Blitzer, Crammer, Kulesza, Pereira & Vaughan — A theory of learning from different domains
sources.used_for: Theorem 2 uses source error + one half the empirical HΔH divergence + finite-sample complexity + the ideal joint-hypothesis error λ. Lemma 2 links an optimal symmetric domain discriminator to empirical H-divergence. The paper does not license replacing field-specific source/target definition, λ, VC dimension, or spatial sampling assumptions with an arbitrary random pixel split.
